findings.title: Imported HTML is stored and rendered without sanitization
findings.body: This marks imported content as `raw_html`, and the embed view renders `post.cooked` as raw HTML. RSS item content is external input, so a feed entry can include script or other executable markup that will be stored and run for forum visitors. The generated “Imported from” link also interpolates the feed item URL into HTML without escaping. Sanitize the content and escape generated attributes before storing it as raw HTML.

findings.title: Standard RSS items without `content` abort the feed poll
findings.body: This assumes every item has a non-nil `content` field, but ordinary RSS items commonly provide their body in `description` instead. Calling `scrub` on nil raises, aborting the poll; because retries are disabled, the remaining items are not imported during that run. Fall back to the available description/content field and handle items with neither.

findings.title: A crash between setting and expiring the throttle key can block retrieval permanently
findings.body: The Redis key is created with `SETNX` and only then given a 60-second expiry. If the worker exits between these commands, the key remains without a TTL, so future retrievals for this URL are throttled indefinitely (except for staff bypasses). Set the key and expiry atomically.
